title: The posting program's input
description: posting/v1 — one JSON object on the program's input, then its end: where to send, a secret, and the meeting's name; for notion, the integration's key too; for a confidential meeting, its confirmation. What a schema cannot say is on the contract's page: which addresses are refused.

key.description: notion alone: the integration's key, a secret.

confirmed_confidential.description: true once the person confirmed sending a confidential meeting, for this send alone; false when absent.
